pages.title: Ministry of Agriculture, Food Sovereignty and Forests - Wikipedia
pages.excerpt:
The**Ministry of Agriculture, Food Sovereignty and Forests**(Italian: Ministero dell'agricoltura, della sovranità alimentare e delle foreste), or**MASAF**, is an[Italian government](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Italian_government)department.

It was formed in 1946[[1]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ministry_of_Agriculture,_Food_Sovereignty_and_Forests#cite_note-:0-1)as the**Ministero dell'Agricoltura e delle Foreste**("Ministry of Agriculture and Forests")[[2]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ministry_of_Agriculture,_Food_Sovereignty_and_Forests#cite_note-:1-2), and following the[referendum](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Italian_referendum,_1993)of 1993 became the**Ministero per il Coordinamento delle Politiche Agricole**("Ministry for Co-ordination of Agricultural Policies"). It was reconstituted in the same year as the**Ministero delle Risorse Agricole, Alimentari e Forestali**("Ministry of Agricultural, Food and Forestry Resources") in 2006[[2]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ministry
